title: specy-road node activity log
description: When each node was last worked on, keyed by node_key. A sidecar rather than node fields: consumer-owned roadmap schemas use additionalProperties:false, so a new node field would break every adopter's validate until they hand-edited a schema — and per-activity writes would churn the chunk diffs that land in every PR.

nodes.description: node_key -> the most recent activity on that node.

at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the activity.

kind.description: What happened. 'backfilled' means the timestamp was derived from git history rather than observed live, so it is a lower bound on real activity.
